title: Radon-criterion bounds for the mass measures: finiteness on compacts, compact lim sup, open lim inf (parent step 2(a)–(c); Simon 7.2.4 (12)–(14))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. For j ∈ ℕ let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P be open and S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j), and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P). Assume (1) for every R ∈ ℝ, closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U_j for all large j; (2) S_j ⇀ C in ℝ^P (ConvergesWeakly); (3) (local comparison) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, every ε > 0 and every strictly increasing ψ : ℕ → ℕ there are an open W with K ⊆ W ⊆ thickening(ε, K) = {x : infEdist(x, K) < ε} and a strictly increasing φ′ : ℕ → ℕ such that limsup_{i→∞} M_W(S_{ψ(φ′(i))}) ≤ M_W(S) for every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with SameBoundary S C (∂S = ∂C, vacuous for n = 0) and spt(S − C) ⊆ K. Let R_j ∈ IMRep(U_j, n) represent S_j for every j, and let R ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) represent C. Write μ_j := R_j.measure = θ_j Hⁿ⌞M_j and μ := R.measure. Then (a) μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (b) limsup_j μ_j(K) ≤ μ(K) for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; and (c) μ(G) ≤ liminf_j μ_j(G) for every bounded open G ⊆ ℝ^P (lim sup and lim inf in [0, ∞]). These are exactly the hypotheses of radon_criterion for (μ_j) and μ. Here M_O(T) = T.massOn O = sup{max(T(ω), 0) : ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(dom T), tsupport ω ⊆ O, |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x} ∈ [0, ∞] (SimonGMT massOn, Simon 6.2.5, Euclidean coefficient norm), spt is GeometricCurrentOn.support (Simon 6.2.11), and currentEval(S_j, ω) = S_j(ω) if ω is a test form with tsupport ω ⊆ U_j and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ j, IsOpen (Us j)) → (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ Us j) → ConvergesWeakly Ss C → (∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 < ε → ∀ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ ∃ φ' : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ' ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S → SameBoundary S C → (S - C).support ⊆ K → limsup (fun j => (Ss (ψ (φ' j))).massOn W) atTop ≤ S.massOn W) → ∀ Rs : (j : ℕ) → IMRep (Us j) n, (∀ j, (Rs j).Represents (Ss j)) → ∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents C → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → R.measure K < ∞) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun j => (Rs j).measure K) atTop ≤ R.measure K) ∧ (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → Bornology.IsBounded G → R.measure G ≤ liminf (fun j => (Rs j).measure G) atTop)
